title: Mobile Check Deposit Limits (2023)
body: Mobile check deposit limits are $2,500 per check and $5,000 total per rolling 30-day period for personal accounts in good standing. Customers who need higher limits can request an increase by visiting a branch with two forms of ID. Deposited funds are typically available within two business days. Checks must be endorsed with 'For Mobile Deposit Only' to be accepted.
